title: Joining Fletcher Henderson
summary: Having saved $500, Roy gambled it away in Philadelphia and then joined Fletcher, where Chu Berry had recommended him; the trumpet section included Thigpen.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: And then, is that when Fletcher...?

Yeah, Fletcher asked me to go with him, and I had saved up about five hundred dollars, and I just figured... I told Fletcher I had to go home, but I didn't get no farther than Philadelphia. I went over there with the five hundred dollars and got stranded, you know, with gambling, and I'd take all my buddies out when I'd go to jam, you know, and buying drinks. I had a silver dollar left, and I pawned that to corral my aunt here in New York to get five dollars to get home. It only cost two dollars and something at that time, you know, on the train. So that's when I joined Fletcher, when I came back there.
Was Chu already with him then?
Yeah. Chu was with the band before I was. That's probably why I was with the band. I think Chu must have told him to get me. Chu, Buster was there, Joe Thomas.
No, Dick Vance wasn't there. A trumpet player named Thigpen. I don't remember Thigpen's first name. Do you know?
Yes, I always keep saying Ed, too.
He's mentioned in that book about Fletcher.
Yeah, he was a good trumpet player, but he was very stiff(?) ...[AIRPLANE OVERHEAD]...
